title: Mental Health Awareness for Students
description: A foundational course helping students understand emotions, stress, peer pressure, and when to seek support.

title: Student Leadership Foundations
description: A leadership course focused on confidence, communication, teamwork, service, and responsibility.

title: Digital Literacy Essentials
description: A practical introduction to digital tools, online safety, research skills, and responsible technology use.

title: Teacher Mental Health Support Basics
description: A practical course for teachers on classroom wellbeing, warning signs, basic support, and referral pathways.

title: Parent Communication and Teen Support
description: A parent-focused course on listening, setting boundaries, digital safety, and supporting emotional wellbeing.

title: Mental Health Club Coordinator Training
description: Training for school coordinators on setting up club meetings, student ambassadors, reporting, and safeguarding.
